title: hibiscus manihot var. zenkeri
intro: Hibiscus manihot var. zenkeri, commonly known as White Sirissa, is a plant species belonging to the Malvaceae family. It is traditionally used to treat various health conditions due to its numerous health benefits, including its ability to lower blood pressure, reduce fever, and act as an anti-inflammatory agent. The therapeutic actions of White Sirissa are attributed to its bioactive constituents, which include flavonoids, anthocyanins, and phenolic acids, that exhibit antioxidant and free radical scavenging properties. Additionally, the plant has been used to treat various digestive issues, and its leaves are used as a natural remedy for sore eyes and wounds.
